summary: Neo wakes from a deep sleep feeling better and begins examining his altered body. He finds a futuristic IV plugged into a jack in his forearm and pulls it out, staring at the grafted outlet. He runs his hand over the short hair now on his head and discovers a large outlet in the base of his skull. As he starts to come unglued, Morpheus opens the door. Neo asks what has happened to him and what this place is. Morpheus redirects the question from where to when, telling him the year is closer to 2197 than 1997, and admits they do not know the exact year. The wind is knocked from Neo's chest. Morpheus then says there is no reason to explain it when he can show it, and tells Neo to come with him.

what_changes.after: Learns it is much closer to 2197, and that no one knows the exact year
what_changes.evidence: You believe the year is 1997 when in fact it is much closer to 2197.

what_changes.before: Wakes from a deep sleep, feeling better
what_changes.after: The wind is knocked from his chest by Morpheus's revelation
what_changes.evidence: The wind is knocked from Neo's chest.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus wakes Neo and reveals that the year is far later than Neo believed.

uncertain: The exact year, since Morpheus says they do not know it
Where this room is located or what building it is in

minds.wants: To re-establish a stable frame of reference — to know what's been done to his body and where he is — so he can stop free-falling.
minds.feels: A rising, bodily panic. His own body has become foreign to him (grafted outlets, shorn hair, a socket at the base of his skull), and each discovery pushes him toward 'coming unglued.' He is trying to solve his body like a puzzle because solving it feels like controlling it.
minds.shows: Questions — 'What's happened to me? What is this place?' — a demand for explanation that is really a demand for solid ground. When Morpheus redirects him from where to when, the answer physically floors him (wind knocked from his chest), and he can only follow.
minds.basis: He wakes 'feeling better,' immediately begins examining himself, pulls the IV and stares at the grafted outlet, explores the skull socket, and is described as starting to 'come unglued' right before Morpheus enters — then fires two questions. The revelation literally knocks the wind from him.

believes_about.belief: That Morpheus is an captor/explainer who owes him answers and can give a coherent account of his situation.
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus withholds explanation on purpose ('no reason to explain it when I can simply show it') and admits he doesn't even know the exact year — Neo is being led, not informed, and the truth will be shown as an ordeal, not a briefing.

believes_about.belief: That the year is still 1997 and his whole life's timeline is intact.
believes_about.wrong_because: This is the belief Morpheus explicitly dismantles: it is closer to 2197. His entire sense of when he is — the ground under his questions — is false.

minds.wants: To move Neo from a demand for verbal explanation toward an experience he can't argue with — to begin breaking Neo's old world without losing him in the process.
minds.feels: Controlled, almost reverent certainty. He has done this before and knows the mind can't take the truth all at once ('the answers are coming,' sc-036), so he doses it. There is no alarm at Neo's panic; he times his entrance to the moment Neo is 'coming unglued,' steadying him rather than letting him spiral.
minds.shows: Calm redirection. He reframes Neo's 'what/where' into 'when,' delivers the date as a clean, devastating fact, admits the one thing he can't know (the exact year), then refuses to explain and instead offers to show. He turns a crisis into an invitation: 'Come with me.'
minds.basis: He opens the door exactly as Neo starts to come unglued, answers questions with a question, gives a precise-sounding correction (2197 vs 1997) while admitting uncertainty about the exact year, and explicitly chooses showing over explaining. This continues his earlier pattern of measured revelation (sc-035-036).

believes_about.belief: That Neo can be guided through the truth a step at a time and won't shatter if the dosage is right.
believes_about.wrong_because: Inferred — this confidence is about to be tested; the coming history lesson will overwhelm Neo to the point of rejection (ev-009), suggesting Morpheus slightly overestimates how much Neo can absorb before his mind revolts.

believes_about.belief: That 'the One' he's been searching for is standing here, frightened and half-rebuilt.
believes_about.wrong_because: Inferred from his certainty in sc-035 ('I know it'); the belief isn't wrong in content yet, but its cost — breaking the rule against freeing older minds (ev-010) — is something Neo doesn't yet know he carries.

connects_back: Morpheus's promise in sc-036 that 'the answers are coming' — this scene is the first installment, delivered in measured doses.

Neo passing out after 'Welcome to the real world' (sc-034) and waking confused (sc-035) — he has never been given a coherent account, so his panic and questioning here are the accumulated residue of being kept half-conscious and operated on.
The physical 'rebuilding' in sc-036 (atrophied muscles, needles) pays off as the grafted ports and shorn body Neo discovers on waking.
sets_up: ev-009: Morpheus's refusal to explain and offer to 'show' it directly sets the pattern for the Construct history lesson — and for Neo's mind rejecting the overload.
ev-010: The date shock and the impossibility of returning to 1997 lay groundwork for Neo learning he cannot go back to the Matrix at all.
ev-011: Neo's discovery of his grafted ports (forearm, skull) anticipates Tank's orientation to his role and the note that Neo lacks standard operator jacks.
ev-008: Neo waking in his own room and confronting his modified body continues directly into the reconstruction/ship-introduction beat.
dramatic_function: This is the pivot from physical rescue to existential vertigo: it transfers the threat from Neo's body to his entire understanding of reality, replacing 'where am I' with 'when am I' so that the ground of his identity — time itself — collapses, priming him to receive the truth as an experience rather than an explanation.
